description: Source code for the patience diff algorithm implementation in the LibXDiff library, including data structures, algorithms for finding longest common sequences, and fallback mechanisms.

classes.name: struct hashmap
classes.description: Data structure used for mapping line hashes to line numbers and managing common record detection.

methods.name: is_anchor
methods.description: Checks if a line matches any of the anchor patterns defined in the xpparam_t configuration.

methods.name: insert_record
methods.description: Inserts a line record into the hashmap, marking it as unique or non-unique.

methods.name: fill_hashmap
methods.description: Fills the hashmap with line records from both files to facilitate sequence matching.

methods.name: binary_search
methods.description: Performs binary search to find the position to insert an element in the sequence for LIS calculation.

methods.name: find_longest_common_sequence
methods.description: Finds the longest sequence of unique matching lines between two files.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Checks if two lines from different files are identical based on their minimal perfect hash.

methods.name: walk_common_sequence
methods.description: Recursively extends the common sequence of lines and applies patience diff to subranges.

methods.name: fall_back_to_classic_diff
methods.description: Uses Myers algorithm as fallback when no unique common sequence is found.

methods.name: patience_diff
methods.description: Main recursive function implementing the patience diff algorithm.

methods.name: xdl_do_patience_diff
methods.description: Public API function to perform patience diff on two files.
